strategy: Harden the existing StarterHostOrchestrator without creating a second session owner. Seal every persisted session, validate an exact closed shape on every load, and require persisted next_action/policy to equal a canonical projection. Persist the exact non-authorizing pending transition input before each STARTING/RESUMING claim. Add StarterWorkflowRuntime.recover() to read a non-running durable LangGraph snapshot and align the existing TaskRun. Add reconcile() that safely starts only a provably unstarted CREATED TaskRun, replays a resume only while the TaskRun is still at its original wait/gate, adopts a newer durable graph snapshot, and blocks ambiguous RUNNING states. Prove real external and Human Gate round trips with temporary verified Starter entrypoints.

changes.responsibility: seal and fully validate session state, derive canonical actions, persist pending transitions, and reconcile interrupted claims
changes.reason: this remains the single Host-session ordering and correlation owner

changes.responsibility: expose read-only recovery of the latest durable non-running LangGraph snapshot and align it with the existing TaskRun
changes.reason: the Starter runtime owns graph/checkpointer reconstruction and TaskRun projection

changes.responsibility: close the sealed session and pending-transition transport shape
changes.reason: persisted recovery state must be versioned and reviewable

changes.responsibility: prove tamper rejection, schema closure, successful external/Human resumes, stale/wrong evidence rejection, and crash reconciliation
changes.reason: the prior suite did not execute these composed boundaries

changes.responsibility: document canonical reconstruction and the exact safe/ambiguous reconciliation rules
changes.reason: Host implementers must not treat stored next_action or a transitional phase as replay authority

unchanged_boundaries: StarterHostOrchestrator remains the only Host-session state owner
ChatGPT/Codex remains semantic interpreter among verified candidates
StarterWorkflowRuntime and LangGraph remain Workflow execution authorities
TaskRun remains lifecycle and completion authority
DurableHostSkillBridge remains Host result and immutable receipt transport
existing WriteAuthorityGuard remains mandatory for mutating effects
external events and Human decisions must carry durable evidence
Graph END remains VALIDATING and automatic merge remains false
customer application source and runtime dependencies remain unchanged
forbidden_repairs: Do not trust or auto-heal an impossible persisted next_action.
Do not add an HMAC secret, new authority store, second TaskRun, or second graph state machine.
Do not blindly replay an ambiguous RUNNING transition or fabricate missing resume evidence.
Do not interpret natural language, grant write authority, complete TaskRun, or add merge capability.
Do not modify customer Agent product source, services, web code, contracts, packaging, or runtime dependencies.
required_invariants: every returned session has exact fields, a valid state digest, and a canonical phase/action/policy relationship
changing next_action, policy, phase, pending transition, runtime state, selection, or TaskRun binding fails closed
pending transition identity is persisted before a runtime call and cleared only after canonical execution publication
reconciliation retries only a CREATED start or an unchanged durable wait/gate with its exact persisted input
reconciliation may adopt only a durable non-RUNNING graph snapshot bound to the same TaskRun and Workflow
ambiguous graph or TaskRun RUNNING state remains blocked for explicit inspection
external and Human Gate resumes preserve the same session and TaskRun and end in VALIDATING rather than COMPLETED

focused: persisted next_action/policy tampering is rejected on read
unknown/missing session fields and digest drift are rejected
a real verified Starter external wait resumes on the exact event/evidence into VALIDATING
a real verified Starter Human Gate resumes on an explicit decision/evidence into VALIDATING
crash after durable start or resume execution is reconciled from the same TaskRun/checkpointer without re-executing the completed step
counterexamples: wrong phase, event, correlation, Human decision shape, missing evidence, stale revision, or unrelated pending transition is rejected
a transitional TaskRun with no provable unstarted wait or newer non-running checkpoint is blocked instead of replayed
automatic_merge, completion authority, and authority_effect cannot be changed in persisted state
regression: existing selection, Host bridge, Starter runtime, TaskRun bridge, Provider, invocation, and orchestrator suites remain green
complete Skill unit and all five required skill-only profiles remain green
negative_path: session sealing does not become write or merge authority
reconciliation does not fabricate evidence or re-run ambiguous effects
standalone customer application source and dependencies remain unchanged

risks: A process may die while an external side effect is in flight before any durable graph checkpoint; reconciliation must classify this as ambiguous and block.
A plain SHA-256 seal detects corruption and unauthorized field changes relative to canonical validation but is not a secret-based defense against an actor who can rewrite both code and files.
Transport-specific ChatGPT/Codex CLI integration remains a later stage and is not added to #2096 hardening.
rollback_plan: Revert the hardening commit to the original #2096 tree. The existing fail-closed STARTING/RESUMING behavior remains, and PR #2096 stays unmerged until a replacement repair is governed.
